# [4.0.0](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/compare/@game-studio/cabinet@3.3.2...@game-studio/cabinet@4.0.0) (2026-07-13)


### Bug Fixes

* **jackpots:** jackpots package was missing peer and dev dependency on howler ([ba95f63](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/ba95f63607c2141f8f191febc39705f151adb11d))


### Features

* **button scaling:** games can now control the size of the floating buttons ([18cf158](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/18cf158438be336acd2bff6954332a1638e136ab))

* **howler:** introduced Howler as our audio management of choice ([bd72408](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio/commit/bd724084d95c8c35bd6c07a3df2fb3176cfda89a))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* **howler:** removal of pixi/sound and introduction of Howler and @types/howler
